passages.provision_quote: It is the policy of the state that eligible renewable energy resources and zero-carbon resources supply 90 percent of all retail sales of electricity to California end-use customers by December 31, 2035, 95 percent of all retail sales of electricity to California end-use customers by December 31, 2040, 100 percent of all retail sales of electricity to California end-use customers by December 31, 2045, and 100 percent of electricity procured to serve all state agencies by December 31, 2035.
passages.note: Digest names Laird as author; Governor approved the chaptered bill within his current Senate term.

rows.reasoning: Laird authored SB 1020, which sets a renewable/zero-carbon retail-sales standard with firm percentage targets tied to specific calendar dates (90% by 2035, 95% by 2040, 100% by 2045). That is a mandate with firm deadlines, matching rung 1, "Require a shift to clean energy through mandates and firm deadlines," per H17's renewable-procurement-standard-with-dates example, and it excludes the subsidy, permitting, neutral, and anti-mandate rungs.
